summary: Independent reruns: journal v2 35 tests, gate 28 result groups, artifact 52 CLI invocations, review 18 groups. Actual same-file provider adoption/destruction and SIGKILL recovery succeed via explicit narrow adapter; immutable journal snapshots verified. New saved-plan substitution deletes retained unticketed resource; forced replacement, incomplete capture/census and raw-state sensitivity remain blockers. Recommend v2 journal plus immutable deployment bundles and provider-side retirement authority.
